title: Payment API returns 500 errors

description: The checkout service rejects valid payment requests after a recent release.

title: Order processing worker crashed
description: The order worker exits with an unhandled exception while processing orders.

title: Search API returns empty results
description: The search endpoint returns empty results even when matching products exist.

title: Invoice generation job failed
description: The billing job cannot generate customer invoices because of an application exception.

title: Profile API response serialization error
description: The profile endpoint fails while converting account data into a response.

title: Recommendation service crash loop
description: The recommendation service repeatedly restarts after a runtime exception.

title: Webhook handler returns 500
description: Incoming payment-provider webhooks fail with an application error.

title: Database connection pool exhausted
description: New requests cannot get a database connection because the pool is exhausted.

title: PostgreSQL replication lag is high
description: Read replicas are several minutes behind the primary database.

title: Database query timeout
description: Customer lookup queries exceed the configured database timeout.

title: Migration lock blocks writes
description: A database migration holds a lock and prevents order updates.

title: Database disk space warning
description: The PostgreSQL data volume is above eighty percent capacity.

title: Slow database query detected
description: A reporting query scans too many rows and slows the dashboard.

title: Database authentication failed
description: The service cannot connect because its database credentials were rejected.

title: Cache database unavailable
description: The session store cannot reach the database used for persistent cache data.

title: External payment gateway timeout
description: Requests to the payment provider time out after thirty seconds.

title: Service DNS lookup failed
description: The order service cannot resolve the inventory service hostname.

title: Load balancer health check failed
description: The load balancer marks all instances of the catalog service unhealthy.

title: High packet loss between services
description: Requests between checkout and payment services fail intermittently.

title: CDN connection issue
description: Static assets load slowly because the CDN origin connection is unstable.

title: Internal API connection refused
description: The notification service rejects connections from the order worker.

title: Network latency increased
description: Requests to the search cluster have unusually high latency.

title: Webhook provider unreachable
description: The external provider cannot deliver webhooks to the public endpoint.

title: User login fails with invalid token
description: Valid users cannot log in because access tokens are rejected.

title: Single sign-on provider unavailable
description: Employees cannot sign in because the SSO provider connection fails.

title: Expired service credential

title: Password reset email token invalid
description: Users cannot reset passwords because reset tokens fail validation.

title: API key rejected by payment provider
description: Payment requests fail because the external API key is invalid.

title: Role permission denied
description: Support users cannot access the incident dashboard due to missing permissions.

title: Authentication rate limit triggered
description: A large number of login attempts causes legitimate users to be rate limited.

title: OAuth callback mismatch
description: Login fails because the OAuth redirect URL does not match the configured value.
